goal: Scope the blast radius of checkout failing.

result.cypher:
// blast_radius: who breaks if this service fails? (callers of callers, up to $maxHops)
MATCH p = (dep:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(s:Service {uid: $service})
WITH dep, min(length(p)) AS hops, collect(p)[0] AS p
CALL algo.betweenness({nodeLabels: ['Service'], relationshipTypes: ['DEPENDS_ON']}) YIELD node, score
WHERE node = dep
OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(dep)
RETURN dep.uid AS service, dep.name AS name, hops, score AS betweenness, dep.tier AS tier, t.uid AS team, p
ORDER BY betweenness DESC, hops ASC
result.summary: 3 services within 3 hops depend on checkout; top: frontend (betweenness 0.42)

result.cypher:
// critical_services: which services are chokepoints of the dependency graph?
CALL algo.betweenness({nodeLabels: ['Service'], relationshipTypes: ['DEPENDS_ON']}) YIELD node, score
OPTIONAL MATCH (node)<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(caller:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (node)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(callee:Service)
RETURN node.uid AS service, node.name AS name, score AS betweenness,
       count(DISTINCT caller) AS dependents, count(DISTINCT callee) AS dependencies
ORDER BY betweenness DESC
LIMIT $limit
result.summary: frontend and checkout are the top chokepoints (betweenness 0.42, 0.31)

result.cypher:
// on_call: who holds the latest rotation week for this service?
MATCH p = (person:Person)-[r:ON_CALL_FOR]->(s:Service {uid: $service})
WHERE r.weekStartTs <= $at
OPTIONAL MATCH (person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
RETURN person.uid AS person, person.name AS name, r.weekStart AS weekStart, t.uid AS team, s.uid AS service, p
ORDER BY r.weekStartTs DESC
LIMIT 1
